missions.synopsis: Recover the missing team ledger. Cross the containment sector, disable its anchor and extract through the emergency lift.
missions.title: BLACKOUT AT SITE-7

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The first anchor is offline, but its carrier did not stop. Re-enter through the service uplink and follow the lower relay chain.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The flooded maintenance run still has active security sensors. I can trace their firing lanes; use the machinery as cover.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Recover the reserve cache before the quarantine crossing. The relay sentinel runs the sublevel shield cycle. Keep an escape lane open.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Routing log first, relay second. Extract early if the squad cannot continue. Full clearance opens the core approach.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The routing log isolates the final carrier path. It runs beneath the bulkhead into the resonance core.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Recovery sweep complete. Refit at base; Core Pressure is now available.

missions.synopsis: Follow the lower relay chain through flooded maintenance. Recover the routing log and disable the sublevel sentinel.
missions.title: RECOVERY SWEEP

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The relay is down. Its log exposes the core approach. Recover the carrier trace before entering the bulkhead.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: More armored drones, no clear corridor. Use the barriers, reload behind machinery and move on the warning gaps.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The final anchor's resonance core survived its broken mast. The arc fork on top is the emitter; the shield phase still blocks our shots.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Secure the resonance sample, disable the anchor, then reach the escape shaft. No one stays behind.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: Site-7 is silent. The resonance sample still carries a trace toward the offshore network.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Chapter 01 complete. All three operations remain available for recovery runs and upgrades. The offshore operation is not deployed yet.

missions.synopsis: Breach the inner defense, recover the carrier trace and shut down the resonance anchor. Return through the escape shaft.
missions.title: CORE PRESSURE

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The carrier trace enters the thermal fabrication spine. Heat is building behind every sealed gate.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: The new prism skimmers are built for the narrow lanes. Use the barriers, then hit the Warden's exposed furnace.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The heat-map should reveal its cycling window. Do not stand in front of the tracked fortress when the core opens.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Recover the trace, disable the Warden and leave before the service lock repressurizes.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The Warden's trace points beyond Site-7. The offshore relay is carrying the carrier's null-space signature.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Forge Descent complete. The offshore operation is unlocked.

missions.synopsis: Descend into Site-7's thermal fabrication spine, disable the Forge Warden and recover the heat-map trace.
missions.title: FORGE DESCENT

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The offshore relay is isolated but still broadcasting. This is the carrier's last stable aperture.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: Null pylons are suppressing the relay. Their lenses are fixed, but their warning circles will bypass cover.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Break the array, keep an escape lane open and do not let the carrier pin the squad against the deck.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Destroy Carrier Null. When the aperture collapses, extract immediately.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: Carrier Null is gone. The offshore trace ends, but something answered from beyond the relay.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Offshore Null complete. The answer signal is tracing back into Site-7's sealed lower wings. Verdant Lock is now available.

missions.synopsis: Cross the offshore transit relay, collapse the jammer array and destroy Carrier Null before the route desynchronizes.
missions.title: OFFSHORE NULL

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The answer signal is coming back through Site-7's sealed lower wings. The hydroponic wing is the first relay, and its air handlers are broadcasting it.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: Null pylons and mortar nests sit behind the planter troughs. The troughs stop shots but not blasts; watch the landing circles.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Long galleries, few gaps. Hold the troughs, let them come to you and never stand still on a vent grate.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Recover the germination log, silence the aerator tower and lift out.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The aerator tower is offline. The germination log points down to the cryo archive; the answer is being stored, not just relayed.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Verdant Lock complete. Cold Storage is now available.

missions.synopsis: Cut through the sealed hydroponic wing, recover the germination log and silence the aerator tower that keeps the answer signal alive.
missions.title: VERDANT LOCK

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The germination log leads down to the cryo archive. Something is being stored there, and its compressors keep the answer from decaying.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Rams and shield crawlers will use the frozen aisles as lanes. Break their line with the vault racks and keep moving.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The compressor stack cycles on a sweep. I can read its frost bars; do not stand where the next one is about to land.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Recover the thermal ledger, shut the compressor down and leave through the cargo lock.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The archive kept the answer on cold media. The dispatch orders in the ledger send it out along the maglev yard.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Cold Storage complete. Switchyard is now available.

missions.synopsis: Descend into the cryo archive, recover the thermal ledger and shut down the compressor that keeps the answer from decaying.
missions.title: COLD STORAGE

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The dispatch orders route the answer through a surface maglev yard. It is open ground; expect fire from every lane.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: Prism skimmers hold the guideways and mortars sit on the switch platforms. Rail-lane warnings will cross the whole yard.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Wide lanes and thin cover. Use the depot racks, keep your squad off the rail lines and do not bunch up.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Recover the dispatch orders, bring down the signal gantry and board the departure capsule.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The gantry is down. The last dispatch order ends at a vault that is on no Site-7 map.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Switchyard complete. Memory Vault is now available.

missions.synopsis: Cross the surface maglev yard at dawn, recover the dispatch orders and bring down the signal gantry before the route reroutes.
missions.title: SWITCHYARD

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: The vault index gives the origin's address. Its stacks answer to a memory spire that remembers where you stood.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The spire echoes: warnings will appear where you were a moment ago. Never stop, and never walk the same line twice.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Drones and pylons hold the nave. Fight from behind the racks and break their lens lines before you advance.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Recover the vault index, erase the spire and extract.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The index is complete. The origin's address is a shaft beneath the vault, straight down.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Memory Vault complete. Zero Point is now available.

missions.synopsis: Enter the sealed memory vault, recover the vault index and erase the spire that remembers every step.
missions.title: MEMORY VAULT

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: This is the source of the answer: one core at the bottom of Site-7. Everything the carrier did was for it.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The core adapts. Its warning lanes converge on you from every side; do not leave the gaps.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: Everything we have met is down here. Ration your reloads, keep an escape lane open and hold every corner.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Recover the answer log, destroy the origin core and get out. No one stays behind.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The core is silent. The answer has stopped, and Site-7 is quiet for the first time since the blackout.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: Chapter 01 complete. All ten operations are available for recovery runs and upgrades.

missions.synopsis: Descend the origin shaft, recover the answer log and destroy the origin core. Then get out.
missions.title: ZERO POINT

weapon_catalog.role: Longer range and faster flight in exchange for lower sustained damage.
Higher burst and longer reach in exchange for a smaller magazine and lower sustained damage.
